policy: An article counts as covered only when its source has been checked and at least five reviewed corpus cases (positive, negative/boundary, and interaction cases where applicable) are linked to executable regression fixtures. Do not treat raw Hangul syllable enumeration, successful conversion, or unreviewed expected output as coverage.
